name: MODAT Magnify
description: Enrich internet infrastructure using MODAT Magnify host, service and DNS observations.
requirements: Install the bundled modat-service and modat-dns-record object templates in MISP
features: 32 meaningful MISP input types; reject unsupported types explicitly.
Map all 129 leaf fields of the detailed-service schema, including deprecated fields when present; normalize singular search port into ports.
Retain all nested service and host data as original JSON attachments, including unknown fields.
Emit existing ip-port, asn, geolocation, x509, software, file, vulnerability, domain-ip and dns-record objects.
Bundle new modat-service and modat-dns-record templates; validate them against the MISP object schema.
Keep DNS TTL, created_at and deleted_at distinct. Never treat deleted_at as last_seen.
Preserve array nesting in JSON; repeat scalar leaves in the typed observation. Web files also get individual file objects.
Link observations to input and related infrastructure; deduplicate shared objects and set discovered attributes to_ids=false.
Bound search pagination; report rate limits and authentication errors without exposing response bodies or credentials.
Use fresh PyMISP UUIDs for generated objects and host attachments across enrichments; deduplicate identical evidence only within the current response.
Preserve multiple reverse-DNS names in dns-record objects and repeated certificate RDNs in the full issuer/subject strings, respecting single-valued standard object relations.
Combine host anycast and classification notes in one ip-port text attribute. Report object names and failing template relations for validation errors, without logging attribute values.
Optional MISP settings use screenshot defaults when unset: max_results=1, page_size=10, timeout=10 seconds, include_dns=true and reverse_dns=true. The API key remains required.

Treat HTTP 403 subscription denials independently per endpoint: try the remaining enabled endpoints, keep earlier permitted search pages and return any generated enrichment objects. Log denied endpoint families without exposing response bodies or credentials.

output.response: results.Attribute includes original input and host JSON evidence; results.Object contains linked observations and derived infrastructure objects.
output.no_results: Return original attribute and empty Object array.
output.partial_failure: HTTP 403 subscription denials do not discard enrichment from other endpoints or earlier search pages. Enabled permitted endpoints are still attempted. Return results when at least one enrichment object was generated; if access was denied and no importable enrichment data was produced, return a subscription error. HTTP 401 authentication failures, other HTTP errors, network failures and malformed responses remain errors.
output.errors: Unexpected input or response parsing failures report the processing stage and exception class. Exception messages, response contents and credentials are not logged or returned.

apikey.description: MODAT API key sent in the Authorization header; Bearer prefix is optional.

max_results.description: Maximum service results and, separately, reverse-DNS search results; not a cap on emitted objects. Direct host lookups return all available services. Missing, null, empty or whitespace-only settings use the default; explicit nonblank values are validated.

page_size.description: Search page size. Final page is sliced to max_results. Missing, null, empty or whitespace-only settings use the default; explicit nonblank values are validated.

timeout.description: Per HTTP request timeout, in seconds. Missing, null, empty or whitespace-only settings use the default; explicit nonblank values are validated.

include_dns.description: Fetch historical zone records for domain/hostname inputs and domain-bearing composites/URLs. Missing, null, empty or whitespace-only settings use the default; explicit nonblank values are validated.

reverse_dns.description: When include_dns is true, direct IP inputs also search A/AAAA history and fetch matching zones. Additional API calls and quota apply. Missing, null, empty or whitespace-only settings use the default; explicit nonblank values are validated.

limitations: No WHOIS endpoint exists in the pinned OpenAPI specification. Website WHOIS features are not treated as API capabilities.
JA3S, JA4S, JA4X and JA4Scan-TLS stay text-valued relations in modat-service; no client JA3 or JA4 type is substituted.
Raw certificate text is human-readable certificate output, not PEM/base64 DER; it is stored as text.
No CPE, malware-file hashes beyond documented web hashes, mail-message, registry, banking or personal/travel data are inferred.
DNS zone lookups return their full record history; max_results does not limit the number of records in a zone.
Quoted input values containing quotes, backslashes or control characters are rejected because DSL escape behavior is undocumented.
No live authenticated API call was made. Offline contract and object validation tests passed.

new: modat-service: service observation, protocol data, fingerprints and scan lifecycle.
modat-dns-record: individual historical DNS resource record, including HTTPS, SOA and SRV.
object_recommendations.existing_updates: None required for this implementation. Reuse current standard templates.
upstream_candidates: A generic DNS observation template or extension of dns-record for rrtype, TTL, record lifecycle, HTTPS priority/target/params and SOA/SRV components.

Dedicated server TLS fingerprint attribute types and a generic network-service observation template. These require MISP core/template coordination; local text relations preserve their current meaning.

installation: Keep modat.py in misp_modules/modules/expansion/ and the entire data/modat directory in misp_modules/data/. Reinstall the package if running an installed distribution.

Copy modat-service/ and modat-dns-record/ from misp_modules/data/modat/ into the MISP object-template repository at app/files/misp-objects/objects/ and refresh templates using the normal administrator update process.
Restart misp-modules, enable modat enrichment in MISP and set apikey. Configure optional result limits, timeout and DNS behavior as needed.
